title: SpongeBob SquarePants - 1x16 - Sandy's Rocket - Squeaky Boots
sourceFilename: SpongeBob SquarePants - 1x16 - Sandy's Rocket - Squeaky Boots.en.srt

cues.rawText:
* who lives in a pineapple
under the sea? *

* absorbent and yellow
and porous is he. *

* if nautical nonsense be
something you wish... *

* then drop on the deck
and flop like a fish. *

I'll meet you downstairs
and show you around.

Wow! What are you
going to do with it?

I'm going to the moon,
Spongebob.

Besides, there's
not enough room
for you.

But i don't take up
that much space.

Well, how about this,
or this, or this?
This isn't for fun-- See this?

I don't have time
for fun and games

And i don't have time
for stowaways.
Can i, can i, huh, please?

All right, y'all can ride
in the cargo hold

But this time, just don't
touch anything, okay?

Will we hunt aliens
on the moon?

This is for
harvesting
moon rocks.

When you're done
playing with rocks
How can you be so naive?

How do you explain
atlantis, cowlicks,
99-Cent stores?

And how about those
mysterious circles

That pop up in
kelp fields overnight?

Spongebob, you
don't know a thing

Now, go home and
get some shuteye.

Be here tomorrow
at the crack of dawn

And leave your crazy
alien notions behind.
This ought to do the trick.

Can't you see
i'm sleeping here?

Well, i know you're going
on that moon trip tomorrow

And i just wanted
to bring you something.

Well, i guess you
won't be needing

This alien repellent
for your trip.

Alien repellent?
Let me see that.

Well, i guess
you're right, Patrick.

We better go spray
those windows.
Look how big it is, Spongebob!

We're just here
to spray the windows

How do you think
we get inside?

This must be
the control room.

We can't hang
around in here.
Not some kind of fun... house.

I don't know,
but let's see
what this does.

Patrick, i don't
think we should...

Wait, i think
this one starts it.

And i happen
to know that that
particular button

Hey, who turned
the heavy back on?

Sometimes that Spongebob is
as dumb as a sack of peanuts.

Oh, it sure looks
a lot like home.

Wait! Don't go
near him, Patrick.

Can't you see this
is all a trick?

The aliens
are projecting
our memories

So you mean to say
they've taken what
we thought we think

And make us
think we thought

Are thoughts we think
we thought?... we think?

Okay, but i'm not
going to fall for it.

Sandy... i forgot
all about her.

Oh, she's going
to hate us for
stealing her rocket

When i bring her back
a real, live alien?

Come on, Patrick,
the more the merrier.

Shh, Patrick, don't let them
know we're on to them.

I saw that
on tv, too.

And see what
he's up to.

Make sure your
gun is pumped.

I think i'm going
to be sick.

Patrick, do you know
what this thing is?

Pardon my french, but
get this thing off me!

Patrick and Spongebob,
get out of my bedroom
And give me back my tentacles.

Up a bit late to
be playing pirate,
aren't ye?

Okay, okay, shoot me,
but don't take me money.

We don't want your
money, moon man.

Look at them
squirming around
in there.

Plenty more where
those came from.

Spongebob, what are
you doing here so late?

It's going on your
permanent record.

Please let me
out of here!

We might have to make
a second trip.

There's no time for that--
Just push harder.

I can't turn my back
on you for two seconds

Without you
causing a whole
mess of trouble.
Just like they was a fresh crop

You done turned
my little science
experiment

You two ought
to be ashamed
of yourself.

Or should i say,
miss alien pants?

Is that what
this is about?

So... you were
an alien all the time

And you didn't
even tell me.
Yeah? Well, i got you now.

Oh, but it's not you
that's got me; it's...

Boy, i can't wait to see
the look on Sandy's face.

We "aliens" would like
a word with you.

* pearl is my daughter,
i'll spit in your eye. *

* oh, ho, pearl's a whale,
and it's her birthday. *
Now can we open the presents?

Presents for me darling
little sardine.

It wouldn't be those
totally hip new flipper slippers

I mean, dad, you really
shouldn't have.

Pearl, those are the finest
fishing boots available.
But i got them for a bargain.
Oh, what am i going to do?

I spent two whole dollars
on these boots
And now i'm stuck with them.

Oh, uh, Mister Krabs,
can i get my paycheck?

Come in, come in,
right this way, laddie.

But not on
these beautiful,
priceless boots.
Uh, sir, i can't see you.

The boots... are in...
the way.

These boots never leave
my sight.

They're the most expensive
and prized possessions i own.

They look just like
any old ordinary boots.

These are the only official
fry cook boots.

Only the finest
fry cooks in
the world
And these boots were given to me

By the most famous fry cook
in the sea.

Uh... well, his name is
not important.

But he was famous all right,
don't you worry.

* i'm ready, i'm ready,
i want those boots! *

Sorry, son, these boots are
far too valuable.

What if i give you
my krusty krab paycheck?

And what if i paint
the krusty krab for free?

A year's supply
of french fry oil.

You're going to give me
a heart attack.

Whoa... you got
yourself a deal.
Do you like my new boots?
Now i'm an official fry cook.

That squeaking is going
to drive us all crazy!

That squeaking is money
to my ears... i mean music.

Ah... money, money, money,
money, money.
What the barnacle is that, huh?

Argh... that was the worst night
i ever weathered.

At least i'll have
some peace and quiet at work.

I can't take the world's
greatest fry cook anymore!
I'll see you in a week.

I, uh, see you're still
wearing them boots.

Could the world's
greatest fry cook do this?

Well, uh, i don't, uh...
i don't, uh...

Yeah, i'll have
the krusty special.

We will squeak
when it's ready.

Could the greatest fry cook do
that, Mister Krabs?

And look at this,
Mister Krabs.

And this... and this...
and this...

And this... and this...
and this... and this...
I got to go to my office!
Those boots have got to go!
Ar, ar, ar, ar, ar, ar...

Oh, Mister Krabs, i'm sorry,
sorry, sorry, i'm sorry.

I lost the boots,
your valuable boots.

Hold it, boy, it's not
the end of the world.

You were right-- I wasn't ready
for those blessed boots.
I heard his order, Mister Krabs.

Could the world's greatest
fry cook do this?

And this... and this...
and this... and this...

Yes, i did it!
I did it!

It's the squeaking
of the hideous boots!

I'm sorry, but i can't take
the infernal squeaking no more!

Um... why did you eat
my boots, Mister Krabs?

Because, lad, you
didn't need them.

It's not the boots,
it's the bootee, uh...

I mean the person
in the boots.
You really think so, Mister Krabs?

Here's your paycheck
i owe you

Ah... a long week away
from bikini bottom

Just me and my darling
daughter pearl.

Oh, don't forget my new
flipper slippers, daddy.
